documents.title: Regulatory Oversight & Energy Transition Capital Allocation
documents.content: Regulatory scrutiny surrounding telecom tariff hikes and carbon compliance policies under the National Green Hydrogen Mission has increased. Capex allocation for Phase 2 Gigafactories remains on schedule with ₹75,000 Crore total commitments.
documents.citation: Annual Report FY26, Page 42, Section: Risk Factors

documents.title: Working Capital & Free Cash Flow Dynamics
documents.content: Operating cash flow conversion moderated to 69% of EBITDA due to inventory buildup in retail operations and front-loaded capital expenditures in 5G network densification. Net debt to EBITDA stands comfortable at 0.72x.
documents.citation: Annual Report FY26, Page 78, Section: Financial Highlights

documents.title: ARPU Growth and Subscriber Metrics
documents.content: Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) increased to ₹181.7/month, driven by 5G user migrations. Total subscriber base reached 481 million with data consumption per user averaging 28.4 GB/month.
documents.citation: Q1 FY26 Presentation, Page 14, Section: Jio Platforms

documents.title: Enterprise AI Transformation & Order Book
documents.content: TCS AI Cloud Unit crossed $1.5 Billion annual TCV run rate. Key partnerships with major hyperscalers accelerated delivery across banking, healthcare, and retail verticals.
documents.citation: Annual Report FY26, Page 24, Section: Strategic Overview

documents.title: Digital Services Growth & Margin Resilience
documents.content: Operating margins held resilient at 20.8% despite wage hikes and discretionary spending moderation. Cloud transformation projects accounted for 58% of total revenues.
documents.citation: Annual Report FY26, Page 31, Section: Management Discussion

documents.title: NPA Metrics & Deposit Mobilization
documents.content: Gross NPA improved to 1.24% while Net NPA settled at 0.33%. Deposit growth outpaced credit growth at 19.4% YoY following post-merger branch optimization.
documents.citation: Annual Report FY26, Page 55, Section: Credit Risk
